_comment: Next Bar T0 surface. Until this file existed, tier-classify.mjs fell back to
the generic defaults, which declare NO T0 globs at all — so migrations and the
account-deletion path both classified T1 and the T0 gate could never fire.
Every T0 rule below must match at least one real file; run
because a dead T0 glob silently leaves a path unprotected.

rules.note: Schema and grants against live user data. Applying one is irreversible without a restore, and 0034-style grant changes can lock every user out of their own rows. Attended window only.
Fresh-project bootstrap schema — same blast radius as a migration.
Destructive and irreversible: deletes an auth user and cascades through every table they own. Also the one route holding the service-role key.
Runs BEFORE every matched route handler, so no per-route control can gate it. A wrong matcher is an un-gateable amplification lever (C2 F1b).
The runner that applies schema changes to a live database, including the drift check that refuses an edited-after-apply file.
DELETES FILES. Backed by a backup step, but an over-broad orphan set destroys live venue media.
Rate limiting for every public route. Not T0 — it cannot destroy data — but a regression here removes the only abuse control the public surface has.
